bugs.what: The 'read the true record, and swear it' option at the Oath-Ground listed only relationship deltas (Tamsin +1, Brother Osk -1, Vell -2) but did not warn that Vell would actually leave the party as a mechanical consequence, not just lose regard. Had to spend an extra turn re-recruiting them.

Standing-loss messaging was inconsistent: the first failed 'press him on the Hundred' against Preceptor Aldous printed '(the Ironbound -1)', but a second identical failed press against the same NPC printed no standing-change line at all, even though the DC kept rising as if a cost were still being tracked.

When a room's action list exceeds ~11 items, 'more in this room' toggles between two fixed pages (p1/2 ↔ p2/2) rather than appending or scrolling, which reads at first like the extra options vanished rather than being paginated.
bugs.where: The Gallows Glade / The Oath-Ground — Circle (general UI pattern)

confusions: The 'press him' action (e.g. at the Oath-Ground) sometimes fired with a flavor line ('You press your case and do not blink.') but no visible mechanical effect, leaving it unclear what it actually changed.

It wasn't obvious early on that crossing the Pass Gate into Marrowgate would lock out unfinished companion-quest holds (Vell's Hollowbrook ledger, Perrin's mother's news) for the rest of the run — the warning appeared right at the gate rather than earlier when those quests were picked up.
suggestions: Flag party-departure risk explicitly in the option text (e.g. 'Vell may leave the party') rather than only showing regard-point deltas.
Make 'more in this room' clearly indicate it's paging (e.g. '(page 2/2, includes previous options)') instead of silently swapping the visible action set.

Consider a gentle reminder near act-boundary gates (like the Pass Gate) earlier in the game, e.g. when a companion's personal quest is first accepted, noting which region it must be resolved in before the point of no return.
